  fi
  /usr/sbin/ip link set dbtun2 mtu 1480 up
  /usr/sbin/ip route replace 172.31.90.12/32 dev dbtun2 src 172.31.90.11
  if ! /usr/sbin/ip link show dbtun3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    /usr/sbin/ip tunnel add dbtun3 mode ipip local 10.100.13.10 remote 10.100.13.12 ttl 64
  fi
  /usr/sbin/ip link set dbtun3 mtu 1480 up
  /usr/sbin/ip route replace 172.31.90.13/32 dev dbtun3 src 172.31.90.11
  ;;
down)

  /usr/sbin/ip route del 172.31.90.13/32 dev dbtun3 2>/dev/null || true
  /usr/sbin/ip link del dbtun3 2>/dev/null || true

  ;;
*)

  ;;
esac
